in_sanskrit.name: Najirul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Victorious, Radiant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Najirul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Najirul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'najas' meaning victory and 'rul' meaning radiant. This name represents the triumph of light over darkness and the shining brilliance of one's spirit.
